import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for poster, heading, body and labels. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{heading}

Posted by: {poster}

{body}
{labels}
""" def create_forum_post(poster: str, heading: str, body: str, labels: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- poster : str The author of the post. heading : str The title of the user's post. body : str The main content of the user's post. labels : list[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string for the forum post. """ # Escape all user-provided strings to prevent XSS attacks safe_poster = html.escape(poster, quote=True) safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Render each label as a element safe_labels = "".join( f'{html.escape(label, quote=True)}' for label in labels ) # Format the final HTML using the predefined template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( poster=safe_poster, heading=safe_heading, body=safe_body, labels=safe_labels )
